h1: NovoTech tube lasers — ULT two- and three-chuck tube and pipe lasers, Ø0.4″ to 14.2″ · value line
intro: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass, straight from the 3D model. The ULT is NovoTech's own tube laser — the value line, built in China to our specification and sold under NovoTech's name: pneumatic self-centring chucks at both ends of the bar, servo-following supports, 1.5 to 40 kW sources and four chuck sizes for round tube from Ø0.4 to 14.2″ and square to 13.8″, on 20, 29.5 or 39 ft bars of up to 2,205 lb. The three-chuck version cuts the last part without a remnant; pneumatic loaders, bundle feeding to 5 tonnes, a ±45° five-axis bevel head and TubesT nesting are options. For sheet and tube on one machine see the ULFT and ULET on the NovoTech fiber laser page; for the premium Turkish tube lasers see Dener. Installed and supported from Mississauga, ON, with a CSA-approved panel and a 1-year warranty.

groups.title: NovoTech tube lasers — the value line
groups.lead: Two- and three-chuck ULT tube lasers in four chuck sizes, Ø0.4 to 14.2″, 20 to 39 ft bars.

faq.q: Which ULT chuck size do I need?
faq.a: Size the chuck to the largest tube you cut. The 016 takes round tube from Ø0.4 to 6.3″ and square to 6.3″ — furniture, fitness equipment, racking and railings; the 024 takes Ø9.4″ and square to 8.9″, the size most fabrication shops buy; the 028 takes Ø11″ and the 036 Ø14.2″ and square to 13.8″, with bars to 2,205 lb for structural tube and pipe. The smaller chucks turn faster — 53.5 rpm against 23 rpm on the 036 — and accelerate harder, so they are quicker on small tube.

With two chucks the rear chuck has to keep hold of the bar, so the last few inches of every bar are scrap. The three-chuck ULT adds a chuck that takes over the bar as it shortens and cuts the last part with no remnant — on 20 to 39 ft bars of stainless or heavy-wall tube that saves material on every bundle. It is built on the 024, 028 and 036 chucks.

The pneumatic loader of the 016 and 024 machines separates one bar from the rack and feeds it to the rear chuck — round tube to Ø8.7″ and square to 8.7″ across the corners. The automatic feeding system takes bundles of up to 5 tonnes and bars up to 606 lb (275 kg), sorting and positioning each bar in a 19-second cycle. The heavy tube of the 028 and 036 machines is placed on the infeed supports by crane. Finished parts slide onto the unloading table.

faq.q: Can it cut bevels for welding?
faq.a: Yes — the optional five-axis head tilts ±45°, so weld preparations, mitred corners and tube-to-tube copes are cut in the same pass as the holes and the parting cut. The standard head cuts square to the tube wall.

The Cypcut tube control holds the cutting database and adjusts the power to the speed through corners. TubesT, BOCHU's tube nesting software, imports the 3D parts, unfolds them onto the profile and nests them along the bar to use the remnant; it is an option and also runs on a PC in the office.

faq.q: How does the ULT compare with the Dener and Senfeng tube lasers?
faq.a: Dener's E-FTL and FTL are the premium machines — built in Turkey with 1 G servo chucks and Dener Canada parts — and the FTL goes to Ø25.2″. Senfeng's value line covers Ø0.5 to 25″ with three- and four-chuck machines and an H-beam line. The ULT is NovoTech's own tube laser for the sizes most shops cut, Ø0.4 to 14.2″, at the lowest price of the three; every model of the three lines is in one table on the tube laser cutters overview.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
